notes: Reader queue-order fix based on the user's 0.8.6.36 runtime log. One book request (1748 chars) was received, but the 9s/length-based watchdogs falsely killed valid slow synthesis/playback and replayed already-started chunks; edge-playback also produced a real NoAudioReceived/MCI error. 0.8.6.37 keeps chunks in strict order, reduces steady chunks to about 220 chars, gives prefetch up to 25s, retries only the not-yet-played prefetch chunk up to twice, and never folds an already-played chunk back into the queue. The local MP3 helper no longer relies on MediaEnded events: it plays for natural media duration (or a file-size-derived fallback) and exits deterministically. Direct Edge playback has a generous watchdog and on real failure falls back once to ordered offline speech for current+future text. Queue-finished logging is edge-triggered to stop multi-megabyte log spam. Confirmed working panel/NUI, strict-trash/economy, Dorna logic, combat core 0.7.10.7 and familiar FIX5 are unchanged.
